reason: A cross-platform desktop shell that wraps the DeepSeek Harness web UI, manages its local dsh backend, and adds tray, auto-start, settings, and update features.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh Web 界面封装为支持托盘常驻、自动启动和更新管理的跨平台桌面应用。
summaries.en: A cross-platform desktop app that wraps the DeepSeek Harness dsh web interface with system-tray persistence, auto-start, settings, and update management.

capabilities: Runs the locally installed dsh CLI as a child process
Loads a localhost web interface in a desktop shell
Can install or upgrade the dsh CLI through npm
Supports system tray persistence and login auto-start
Can perform application self-updates on supported platforms
Stores dsh profiles, sessions, and settings locally
